final: WITH base AS (SELECT CENTROMEA AS status, HGB, CAST("T-BIL" AS REAL) / CRE AS ratio FROM Laboratory WHERE Date >= '1985-04-22' AND Date <= '1994-03-14'), grp AS (SELECT status, AVG(HGB) AS avg_hgb, AVG(ratio) AS avg_ratio FROM base GROUP BY status), m AS (SELECT AVG(avg_ratio) AS overall FROM grp) SELECT g.status, g.avg_hgb, g.avg_ratio, g.avg_ratio / m.overall AS ratio_to_overall FROM grp g CROSS JOIN m WHERE m.overall IS NOT NULL
